verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a concrete seller catalog pipeline. Merchants format a CSV feed, upload it through the v2 Product Catalog Import API to a presigned URL, and choose daily product or 15-minute inventory/pricing cadences and replace-mode deletion. Indexing results arrive via webhooks with a per-row error CSV, and restricted keys need Product Catalog Imports permission. The docs frame this as sharing product, price, and availability with agents, after per-agent approval. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the import flow, evidence that service catalogs (not just physical goods) can be published, and broad availability beyond private preview and per-agent approval gating.
